name: John Richardson — parents (Thomas Richison & Mary Mallalieu)
researcher_question: Who were the parents of John Richardson, born 24 July 1833 in Preston, Lancashire, England, an LDS pioneer who emigrated via Nauvoo to Utah and died 10 March 1906 in Richmond, Cache County, Utah?
notes: Ground truth (from the FamilySearch tree): father Thomas 'Thos' Richison (b. 18 Feb 1804 Wigan, Lancashire, England; d. 3 Nov 1886 Richmond, Cache, Utah), mother Mary Mallalieu (married name Richardson; married Thomas 12 Nov 1826 Walton-le-Dale, Lancashire; d. 9 Mar 1846 Nauvoo, Hancock, Illinois; b. 16 Sep 1802 per Find a Grave, year debated — the tree's 16 Sep 1806 Chorley christening is a misattributed record for a different Mary Mallalieu who died 1812; see README correction log). The MOTHER is the hard crux: she died in Nauvoo in 1846, before the family reached Utah, so she appears in NONE of the abundant Utah records (census, militia, death certificate, obituary). Recovering her requires the Nauvoo community records plus the 1826 Lancashire marriage. The father is the medium half: he IS in Utah records but under surname spelling variants (Richison/Richeson/Richardsen) and has a tangled marital history (a 'separation from Anna Owen' event, 1855). John's own English christening is recorded under the surname 'Richards' at Ashton-under-Lyne though he was born in Preston — a spelling+place mismatch. Both parents and John share a documented Nauvoo residence (1839-1846) and a joint 1852 emigration, giving a strong migration/FAN correlation once the England-Utah bridge is made.
